label: Heavy and uneasy
summary: Two Asian disasters dominate. A Himalayan glacier collapse on the Nepal-Tibet border has killed at least 160 with more than 700 missing, while El Niño-driven wildfires put 3.4 million Indonesians at respiratory risk and pushed haze into Malaysia and Singapore. Russia hit Kyiv with ballistic missiles, Israel kept striking Syria and Lebanon despite US diplomatic pressure, and Nigeria ordered a manhunt after gunmen killed more than 40 and seized hundreds in Niger state. Diplomacy flickered: Qatar's prime minister flew to Tehran to try to restart US-Iran talks. Markets were flat to soft on hot inflation data, though Nvidia's bullish outlook lifted futures; Argentina's peso set another record low. The clearest good news was a Senegalese-made sickle cell drug and NASA's Roman telescope, cleared for Sunday launch. No editorial adjustment.
